entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Grzegorz Wojciech Ryś is a Polish Catholic prelate, academic and theologian who has served as Archbishop of Kraków since 2025. He was previously an auxiliary bishop of the Archdiocese of Kraków from 2011 to 2017 and Archbishop of Łódź from 2017 to 2025. He also served as an apostolic administrator of the Diocese of Kalisz from 2020 to 2021. Pope Francis made Ryś a cardinal in 2023.
